_comment: Personality traits (#176). docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-traits-design.md is the design; core/traits.gd reads this file. Every effect is {when, gives, text?}: `when` keys biome/board/night/band/site are decided at fight start and are live now; bloodied/first_round/vs_*/dtype_* are per roll and wait on step 2; `gives` keys ac/to_hit/save/initiative are live in a fight now, the rest (skill, travel, forage, save_adv, damage, gold, opinion...) are shown and marked not yet in play. The numbers are placeholders until tests/sweep_traits.gd measures them (spec §9 step 2).

brave.name: Brave
brave.text: Walks toward the thing everyone else is backing away from.

effects.text: Advantage on a hardship's fear save
−2 when the company tries to slip past a band

craven.name: Craven
craven.text: Alive, which is more than can be said for some of the brave ones.

effects.text: Disadvantage on a hardship's fear save

wrathful.name: Wrathful
wrathful.text: Hurt them and they hit back harder. Talk to them and they hit back too.

effects.text: A failed faction save turns to a grudge, not a haunting

calm.name: Calm
calm.text: Keeps a spell held and a head level when the room is on fire.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.text: Counts the purse before the wounded.

effects.text: −5 with every hero in the company who is not Greedy

generous.name: Generous
generous.text: Gives away the last of the bread, and people remember it.

effects.text: Opinion of them warms a day faster

curious.name: Curious
curious.text: Opens the box. Always opens the box.

effects.text: +2 to investigate and to search a lair
−1 on saves against traps and hazards

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.text: Looks at the floor before stepping on it.

effects.text: −1 on the road's checks (stops to look at everything)

marsh-bred.name: Marsh-bred
marsh-bred.text: Grew up where the ground is half water. Knows which half holds.

woods-born.name: Woods-born
woods-born.text: Can tell a deer track from a wolf's by the smell of the mud.

downs-rider.name: Downs-rider
downs-rider.text: Raised on open grass under a big sky. Sees them coming.

cave-dweller.name: Cave-dweller
cave-dweller.text: Born under rock. The sky still feels like it might fall.

street-raised.name: Street-raised
street-raised.text: Learned to fight in alleys and to talk in taverns.

night-owl.name: Night-owl
night-owl.text: Most awake when everyone else is asleep.
